title: 图片平滑器
summary: 对灰度图每个单元格，取它及周围八个有效单元格的平均值向下取整，生成平滑图像。
insight: 逐格枚举以它为中心的 3×3 区域，只累计仍在矩阵边界内的坐标。
pitfalls: 边界与角落的邻居数量少于九
平均值使用整数除法向下取整
结果不能覆盖输入后再继续读取

solutions.title: 逐格扫描有效邻域
solutions.idea: 为每个输出位置独立计算邻域和与数量。
steps: 对每个 row,column 枚举 deltaRow、deltaColumn∈[-1,1]
合法邻居累加 sum 和 count，写入 sum/count

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] imageSmoother(int[][] img){int rows=img.length,columns=img[0].length;int[][] answer=new int[rows][columns];for(int row=0;row<rows;row++)for(int column=0;column<columns;column++){int sum=0,count=0;for(int dr=-1;dr<=1;dr++)for(int dc=-1;dc<=1;dc++){int r=row+dr,c=column+dc;if(r>=0&&r<rows&&c>=0&&c<columns){sum+=img[r][c];count++;}}answer[row][column]=sum/count;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun imageSmoother(img:Array<IntArray>):Array<IntArray>{val rows=img.size;val columns=img[0].size;val answer=Array(rows){IntArray(columns)};for(row in 0 until rows)for(column in 0 until columns){var sum=0;var count=0;for(dr in -1..1)for(dc in -1..1){val r=row+dr;val c=column+dc;if(r in 0 until rows&&c in 0 until columns){sum+=img[r][c];count++}};answer[row][column]=sum/count};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<vector<int>> imageSmoother(vector<vector<int>>& img){int rows=img.size(),columns=img[0].size();vector<vector<int>> answer(rows,vector<int>(columns));for(int row=0;row<rows;++row)for(int column=0;column<columns;++column){int sum=0,count=0;for(int dr=-1;dr<=1;++dr)for(int dc=-1;dc<=1;++dc){int r=row+dr,c=column+dc;if(r>=0&&r<rows&&c>=0&&c<columns){sum+=img[r][c];++count;}}answer[row][column]=sum/count;}return answer;} };
